title: Cycles of entangled qubits form a non-local proto-space-time

statements.text: A causal set is Boolean because it forbids cycles, while in a quasi-ordered set the cycles carry entangled qubits and form a non-local, non-causal proto-space-time, and micro-causality and locality are restored on the unentangled qubits that are the states of quantum space-time.

sources.quote: This structure, which is non-local and non-casual, can be understood as a proto-spacetime
